about: The "Realistic" look of the model buildings of the 3D page (Layers > Style > Realistic, ?look=real), made by tools/build-materials.mjs (do not edit by hand) from OSM tags and points, the registry use and the model geometry. Valid while model.fp matches the page (MFP). Per model index: c = code (2 base-36 digits: style x 8 + shopfront x 4 + storey class), w = wall colour (2 base-36 digits into wall), p and f = pitched and flat roof colour (2 base-36 digits into roof), u = use for Night (0 unknown, 1 homes, 2 offices, 3 hotel), e = evidence bits (3 base-36 digits: 1 building:material, 2 building:colour, 4 roof:material, 8 roof:colour, 32 shop tag, 64 shop point, 128 registry use, 256 storey from levels); everything without a bit is a guess by the rules.

styles.about: house: sash-proportion windows with frames, a door on some ground-floor bays
slab or tower block: wide windows and spandrel bands
ribbon windows: a glass band along each floor
curtain wall: glass with mullions and a spandrel at each floor
industrial or warehouse: cladding ribs, a plinth, few windows
